title: Marginal Log-Likelihood Increments under Dirichlet-Smoothed Markov Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For a Dirichlet-smoothed transition model, the effect of adding one workflow trace to the training archive is an exact change in reference-weighted log likelihood. We derive that change and show that it is a weighted reduction of Kullback--Leibler divergence between the reference conditionals and the model. From this form we obtain an upper bound on the gain available to any acquisition, which expresses a millinat difference as a share of what is attainable, an exact covariance identity for the effect of the reference weighting, and a sign criterion for the interaction between two candidates, from which the batch objective is neither submodular nor supermodular. A case study on the BPI Challenge 2012 loan-application log measures all three and finds a positive selection result in one of the four combinations of reference weighting and budget unit. translated_title: 狄利克雷平滑马尔可夫估计下的边际对数似然增量
translated_abstract: 对于一个狄利克雷平滑的转移模型，向训练档案中添加一条工作流轨迹的效果是参考加权对数似然的精确变化。我们推导出这一变化，并证明它是参考条件分布与模型之间Kullback–Leibler散度的加权缩减。基于这一形式，我们得到了任何采集策略所能获得增益的上界，该上界将毫纳特差异表示为可达成总量的份额；得到了刻画参考加权效应的精确协方差恒等式；以及判定两个候选样本之间交互作用方向的符号准则，由此可知批处理目标既非次模也非超模。在BPI Challenge 2012贷款申请日志上的案例研究对这三项结果进行了测量，并在参考加权与预算单位的四种组合之一中发现了正向选择结果。在该组合中，对于在相同描述符和相同标签上拟合的两个回归器，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文推导了向狄利克雷平滑马尔可夫模型添加一条工作流轨迹时参考加权对数似然的精确增量，证明其等价于KL散度的加权缩减，并由此导出采集增益上界、参考加权效应的协方差恒等式以及候选交互符号判据，表明批处理目标既非次模也非超模。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the exact marginal log-likelihood increment from adding a workflow trace to a Dirichlet-smoothed Markov model, proves it equals a weighted KL-divergence reduction, and uses this form to obtain an upper bound on acquisition gain, a covariance identity for reference weighting, and a sign criterion showing the batch objective is neither submodular nor supermodular.
